newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-ELBER DOUBLE SINKS SECOND DIVISION COTTBUS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ELBER DOUBLE SINKS SECOND DIVISION COTTBUS.

text.p: Giovane Elber scored twice to lead VfB Stuttgart to a 2-0 win over second division Cottbus Energie in the German Cup final on Saturday.
It was Stuttgart's third success in a competition they last won in 1958.
Bayern Munich-bound Elber headed in a corner from Krassimir Balakov in the 18th minute and flicked a second goal over the head of Cottbus goalkeeper Kay Wehner in the 52nd minute.
"It is such a tremendous feeling -- like a gigantic orgasm," said Elber.
Stuttgart, fourth in the Bundesliga, will play in the European Cup Winners' Cup next season, handing their UEFA Cup place to 1860 Munich.
Cottbus Energie created plenty of chances and were no pushovers for the clear favourites.
Their best opportunity fell to Detlev Irrgang who had the goal at his mercy in the 48th minute but shot straight at goalkeeper Franz Wohlfahrt.
